pillar_reactions.evidence: Presented via screen-share of Primal University rather than as part of the 1:1 offer — kettlebell foundations, steel maces, the primal movement and lymphatic bounce routines. Prospect engaged and asked mechanics questions rather than volunteering excitement: 'And typically, a workout would take how long?' and 'And this works on an app, right?' He recognised his own routine in it — 'Warm-up mobility routine, like a cool-down flexibility, like a longer one' — and said 'Brilliant.'

Delivered in a single line — 'the second thing is nutrition, his simple nutrition protocol, nutrition plan, and about fasting also.' Prospect's entire response was 'Right.' No questions, no pushback, and the rep never connected it to anything the prospect had said. Note the prospect never disclosed a single thing about his diet, so nothing was there to connect it to.

Presented as community rather than coaching: 'once a week, there's a live training session with Trevor, like a group training session. There's also a Q&A over there, so you can actually interact with him.' Prospect acknowledged and moved on. The rep had explicitly framed the prospect as not needing it — 'You don't need hand-holding from Trevor' — so the accountability pillar was argued away rather than sold.

anchors.raw: this primal university is only two hundred dollars a month and you can cancel whenever you want
anchors.note: The rep introduced the anchor himself. A prospect who arrived on a call for a several-thousand-dollar 1:1 programme left with $200/month as the reference price for Primal Instinct's product. If he ever returns for the 1:1, the $6,000 has to clear a 30x gap that the company created.

anchors.raw: if you would like to go for a whole year with this primal university, it will be, yeah, not like $2,000, like get a discount, but go check it out, $2,000, and that's it
anchors.note: Improvised and self-contradicting — $200/month is $2,400 a year, so $2,000 is a discount the rep first denied was a discount and then quoted anyway. A second, lower anchor set in the same breath as the first.

anchors.raw: recently I've joined a program with a guy called Roy Gold, Goldsmith. I'm not sure if you're familiar with him. He's more into movement... It was like a three-month program.
anchors.note: A three-month structured coaching programme the prospect had just completed and reports genuine progress from — pancake improved from a 90-degree angle to roughly 50 cm off the floor. Price was never asked for, so the rep disqualified without ever learning what this prospect already pays for coaching. That is a live version of the known script gap around a cheaper alternative that worked.

anchors.raw: since I started working on more suspension, like calisthenics and a lot of work with my body weight, I kind of rebuilt muscular around my spine, which obviously is supporting the spine. So I don't have any more aches
anchors.note: The prospect solved a two-disc lumbar herniation on his own without paid coaching. That is the strongest possible anchor against paying for structure and it went entirely unaddressed.

unmet_demand.want: Handstand and pancake progression — the two skill targets he named as what he is actively working towards
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme is kettlebell and mace based. The rep set the handstand aside rather than addressing it — 'The handstand is something right aside, so I'm not working or focused on that' — and nothing in the Primal University tour spoke to end-range calisthenics skill work.

unmet_demand.want: A short trial before paying anything
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The rep did not know whether one exists — 'I don't know. I don't think so. Well, I don't think so' — and substituted cancel-anytime.

unmet_demand.want: Individually tailored programming at his sophistication level, which is what he booked the call to explore
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme genuinely offers this through Trevor 1:1, but the rep argued the prospect out of it on the assumption that advanced trainees do not need tailoring — 'it's not tailored specifically to an individual, but with you and your sophistication level... I think you can follow this along.'
